summary: Report durable mail expiry on sender delivery status without enabling expiry writers

replay.detail: No replay or new receipt is introduced. Real delivered/read evidence supersedes expiry.

schema.detail: The client Message.state schema accepts expired. Generated string-based message models stay compatible; the registry and receipt wire formats are unchanged.

rules.detail: Sender delivery status reports terminal expired state and phase with its durable reason before hold/path diagnostics; unavailable remote receipt hosts cannot replace it with unknown. The completed unread expiry migration skips its extra write transaction on reopen.

compatibility.detail: Rust string-based message models accept expired. Older TypeScript Message.state decoders reject it even in tolerant mode: upgrade fractal-web and generated TypeScript consumers before enabling any expiry writer, alongside sender and mailbox readers. Exhaustive downstream state switches may need an expired arm. No negotiation mechanism, writer or harness receipt change is included.

recovery.detail: Expiry remains durable history; this sender endpoint adds no history field or recovery action.
